metadata.title: How SpaceX Stock Can Hit $900<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
How SpaceX Stock Can Hit $900
Wall Street loves SpaceX stock. The average analyst price target is about $240, valuing Elon Musk’s rocket and AI company a cool $3.2 trillion, more than Microsoft, Amazon.com, or even Tesla.
